# Partition map: squeezebox-rg35xxh-<variant>.img (GPT, sunxi-aware)
#
# Allwinner BROM loads the SPL from raw sector 16 (8 KiB), which collides with
# a stock GPT array (sectors 2-33). Our array lives at LBA 4096 (written by
# mksunxi_gpt.py); standard tools (sfdisk, kernel, U-Boot part_efi) parse it.
# Generated bytes are deterministic: fixed GUIDs/PARTUUIDs + $SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
#
#   LBA 0              protective MBR (0xEE)
#   LBA 1              GPT header, primary (disk 0a1b2c3d-0000-...)
#   sectors 16..4095   RESERVED: SPL blob @16 (u-boot-sunxi-with-spl.bin),
#                      U-Boot FIT @512, grown from build-uboot.sh staging
#   LBA 4096..4127     GPT partition array, primary (128 entries)
#   p1 BOOT            32768..557055 (16 MiB @16 MiB, 256 MiB FAT32)
#                      type EFI System, PARTUUID 0a1b2c3d-0001-...,
#                      label SQUEEZEBOOT, files: boot.scr Image dtb.img [overlays/]
#   p2 ROOTFS           557056..end-33 (ext4, label squeezebox-root,
#                      PARTUUID 0a1b2c3d-0002-...), mounts /
#   last 33 sectors    GPT array + header, backup
#
# Variants: ddr3 vs ddr4 differ ONLY in the SPL blob (DRAM timings) written at
# sector 16; partition bytes are identical. Unit DRAM-ID method: TBD on HW.
